name: Pomodoro Island
description: Reference plugin for declarative Workbench and the structured QxIsland session protocol, with persistent background timing and history.

descriptions.zh-CN: 带休息提醒的专注计时器。

author: mcx

preferences.label: Focus minutes
preferences.description: Length of a focus session in minutes.

descriptions.en: Length of a focus session in minutes.

preferences.label: Short break minutes
preferences.description: Length of a short break in minutes.

descriptions.en: Length of a short break in minutes.

commands.name: start-focus
commands.title: Pomodoro: Start Focus
commands.description: Start a focus timer in the Qx-managed island.

descriptions.en: Start a focus timer in the Qx-managed island.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在 Qx 灵动岛中开始专注计时。

commands.name: start-short-break
commands.title: Pomodoro: Start Short Break
commands.description: Start a short break in the Qx-managed island.

descriptions.en: Start a short break in the Qx-managed island.
descriptions.zh-CN: 在 Qx 灵动岛中开始短休息计时。

commands.name: toggle-pomodoro
commands.title: Pomodoro: Pause or Resume
commands.description: Pause or resume the timer; after completion, start the recommended next phase.

descriptions.en: Pause or resume the timer; after completion, start the recommended next phase.
descriptions.zh-CN: 暂停或继续计时；完成后开始建议的下一阶段。

commands.name: stop-pomodoro
commands.title: Pomodoro: Stop
commands.description: Stop the timer and dismiss its island display.

descriptions.en: Stop the timer and dismiss its island display.
descriptions.zh-CN: 停止计时并关闭灵动岛显示。

commands.name: pomodoro-heartbeat
commands.title: Pomodoro: Background Heartbeat
commands.description: Reconcile the persisted timer while its Workbench is closed.

descriptions.en: Reconcile the persisted timer while its Workbench is closed.
descriptions.zh-CN: 面板关闭时校准已保存的计时器。
